title: The Empyrean Cam Ranh Beach Resort continues to support World Cleanup Day 2026

contentBlocks.value: This year, The Empyrean Cam Ranh Beach Resort is once again teaming up with Let’s Do It Vietnam for World Cleanup Day through our event: “Green Day 2026 – For a Green, Clean, and Beautiful Bai Dai Beach.” This is our practical way to help clean the beach and protect the beautiful nature of Cam Ranh Bay.
This great award proves our hard work in bringing the best services to our guests while staying strongly committed to green and sustainable tourism.
